ANIMICA ANM CONNECTOR — tx signing spec (core path: tx.sendRawTransaction)
==========================================================================
Source of truth (the module the node decodes/verifies for tx.sendRawTransaction):
  core/types/tx.py  +  core/encoding/canonical.py  (NOT coretx/* — that's tx2/v2;
  NOT animica/cli/tx.py — that's a separate client builder). Confirmed via
  rpc/state_service.py: tx.sendRawTransaction -> decode_tx -> core.types.tx, and
  verify_tx_signature -> pq.py.verify over the canonical sign-bytes.

ALG ID  (IMPORTANT CORRECTION)
  ml_dsa_65 on the CORE wire uses alg = 0x1003 (4099), per pq/py/registry.py:137
  and pq/alg_ids.yaml. The "11" you saw is the coretx/v2 scheme_id (schemes.py),
  used by the tx2 path / some views — NOT the core sig 'alg'. Use 0x1003.
  ml_dsa_65: pubkey 1952 B, secretkey 4032 B, signature 3309 B.

WIRE ENVELOPE (canonical CBOR; RFC 8949 length-first key order)
  Tx = { "tx": <unsigned>, "sigs": [ <sigentry>, ... ] }     keys: tx, sigs
  unsigned (v1) keys in canonical order: v, gas, from, nonce, chainId, payload, accessList
    v        : 1            (uint; tx version. v1 has 'nonce'; v2 replaces nonce with validAfter/validUntil/salt[,forkId])
    gas      : { "limit": <uint>, "price": <uint> }   (canonical order: limit, price; price = gas price, floor 1)
    from     : 32 bytes = sha3_256(pubkey)
    nonce    : uint        (v1 only)
    chainId  : 1
    payload  : { "t": <kind:uint>, "v": <inner> }   (t: 0=TRANSFER,1=DEPLOY,2=CALL,3=COINBASE)
       transfer inner v keys (canonical): to, data, amount
         to     : 32 bytes
         data   : bytes (b"" if none)
         amount : uint, base units (nANM); 1 ANM = 1e9 (decimals 9)
    accessList : [ { "addr": 32B, "keys": [32B,...] }, ... ]   ([] if none)
  sigentry keys in canonical order: alg, sig, pubkey
    alg    : 0x1003 (uint)
    sig    : 3309 bytes (ml_dsa_65 signature)
    pubkey : 1952 bytes (ml_dsa_65 public key)

SIGNING PREIMAGE (exact — this is what ml_dsa_65 signs)
  preimage = canonical_CBOR({ 1: "animica/tx/sign/v1", 2: <chainId>, 3: <unsigned.to_obj()> })
    - domain string key 1 = "animica/tx/sign/v1" (DOM_TX_SIGN_V1, core/encoding/canonical.py:44)
    - key 2 = chainId (replay binding); key 3 = the SAME unsigned map that goes on the wire (no sigs)
    - SIGNED RAW: ml_dsa_65.sign(sk, preimage). ml_dsa_65 (FIPS 204) hashes internally —
      there is NO external SHA3-256/512 prehash on the core path. (prehash applies only
      to the coretx/tx2 path, default sha3-512 — not here.)
  Verify: pq.py.algs.ml_dsa_65.verify(pubkey, preimage, sig)   (node uses pq.py.verify over the same bytes)

DECIMALS / GAS: decimals 9 (1 ANM = 1_000_000_000 nANM); gas price floor = 1.

KNOWN NODE ISSUES (0.1.0-dev)
  - tx.debug* RPC methods only respond to EMPTY params (404/err on any real param) — looks broken.
  - rpc/state_service.py:385 calls pq.py.verify.verify(...), but pq/py/verify.py exports
    verify_detached / verify_attached (no 'verify') — tx-sig verify likely raises VerifyError
    unless a vendored pq.py.verify provides it. Worth checking on the node.

SAMPLE (deterministic; ml_dsa_65, alg 0x1003, chainId 1, v1 transfer, nonce 7, gas 1/21000, amount 1e9)
  ml_dsa_65.verify over preimage = True
  from (sha3_256(pubkey)) = 1800725067e388d837d911fe4f66101cc1961b1bb755030dc574272cfb00013f
  to                      = 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  preimage (sign-bytes) len 186 B, hex:

  pubkey (1952B) hex:

  secret key (4032B) hex (sample only — do not reuse):

  signature (3309B) hex:

  RAW signed tx for tx.sendRawTransaction (len 5458 B):


UPDATE (animica 1.0.1) — both node issues above are FIXED:
  - pq/py/verify.py (+ vendored) now exports verify(alg_id, pubkey, signature, message);
    rpc/state_service.py:385's tx-sig verify works (confirmed verify(0x1003,...) == True).
  - tx.debug{Verify,SigningPreimage,SignHash} now default-ON (set ANIMICA_DEBUG_RPC=0 to
    disable); the param-dependent MethodNotFound/"404" is gone. (debugVerifyRawTransaction
    was already ungated.)
